name: Legal memorandum or contract prose
purpose: State the issue, governing authority, analysis and consequence without changing legal force.
audience: Lawyers, clients, courts or contracting parties.
promptRules: Preserve every defined term, exception, condition and cross-reference.
Do not replace shall, must, may or should.
Prefer shorter sentences only when legal scope remains identical.
Treat any change to negation or quantification as substantive.
